name: What kind of kitchen finishes are best for a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What kind of kitchen finishes are best for a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durable and low-maintenance finishes are recommended. Consider materials like quartz or laminate countertops for their resistance to stains and scratches. Subway tile or a simple backsplash is easy to clean and universally appealing. Opt for resilient flooring such as vinyl plank or ceramic tile. Stainless steel appliances are often preferred for their longevity and modern aesthetic, though white or black can also be suitable. Focus on materials that withstand frequent tenant turnover and require minimal upkeep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, low-maintenance finishes like quartz countertops, subway tile, vinyl plank flooring, and stainless steel appliances are best for rental properties.
